item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk medication. Your day has real structure around it — meditation, movement, check-ins, wind-down routines — and medication works the same way: it only holds up if it's consistent, not just when things feel calm. Busy days like this one, with an evening out, are exactly when doses get skipped or forgotten. Action: take it now, before the day pulls you in different directions.
